newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins dawdle, have no clue on trend.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins dawdle, have no clue on trend.

text.p: were little changed in quiet trading on Friday as the market had
little indication about further trends, dealers said.
"It is an absolutely dead day when there is nothing to talk about. Just a few deals were struck," one dealer said.
Prices are staying at this morning's levels, with spreads narrower in thin trading, dealers said.

"No U.S. (statistics) figures are due until next week and no clear trend is seen. The market seems to have no clue where to go in this situation," National Reserve Bank dealer Andrei Ivanov-Golitsyn said.
MinFins closely track Brady Bonds and other emerging market debt.
Dealers said prices were likely to fluctuate in the current ranges over the next two days.
